recovery.reason: Executor scratch was lost during a pause before the closing files were published.
recovery.source: Same official CI artifact, preserved inspection records and coordinator expected-files inventory.
recovery.expectedInventorySource: Coordinator-preserved list of 118 closing paths, sizes and hashes.

limits: Inspected means opened in the real pre-reset session; recovery did not repeat image inspection.
Generated documents have new bytes and hashes; previous identities are provenance, not equality claims.
Image inventory includes uninspected files; selectedAndPreserved identifies durable copies.
Raw CI logs, environment values, credentials, private request bodies and executor paths are not included.
